map.text: The lime pin is a smart bay: the barrier keeps it free until you arrive.
detail.notReservable: Reservation is not available at this station.

Your spot,
held for you.
state.REQUESTED.title: Reserving…
state.RESERVED.title: Bay held for you
state.RESERVED.sub: The barrier keeps your spot free.
state.PLATE_MISMATCH.title: Is this you?
state.PLATE_MISMATCH.sub: A car with another plate arrived at your bay.
state.BLOCKED.title: Bay occupied
state.BLOCKED.sub: Another vehicle is in your reserved bay.
state.UNVERIFIED.title: Status unverified
state.UNVERIFIED.sub: We can't confirm the bay right now. Never shown as free.
state.ARRIVED.title: You're in
state.ARRIVED.sub: Barrier is down. Plug in to start.
state.CHARGING.title: Charging
state.COMPLETED.title: Session finished
state.CANCELLED.title: Cancelled
state.CANCELLED.sub: Reservation cancelled. The bay is free for other drivers.
state.NO_SHOW.title: No-show
state.NO_SHOW.sub: Reservation expired. The bay was released for other drivers.
state.FAILED.title: Couldn't reserve
state.FAULT_REPORTED.title: Bay reported
state.FAULT_REPORTED.sub: Thanks. No fee. The operator was informed.
dev.title: Demo · mock hardware
err.out_of_service: This bay is out of service.
err.driver_has_active: You already have an active reservation.
err.hardware_error: The bay did not respond. Try again or pick another bay.
login.hint: Prototype accounts: driver1@demo.test or driver2@demo.test, password demo1234
slots.note: Reservation fee per slot, separate from the charging price (billed per kWh). Arrive before the slot ends; the bay is held until then. Peak hour 16:00–19:00 costs more. Example prices.
state.SCHEDULED.title: Slot booked
state.SCHEDULED.sub: The barrier holds the bay from your slot start. Until then walk-ins may charge here.
err.bad_slot: That slot is gone, pick another.
err.slot_taken: Someone already booked this slot. Pick another time.
slots.pickOnMap: Pick a bay and a time slot on the map first.
charge.note: Charger data is simulated (no charging API yet). Charging is billed per kWh by the charge point operator, shown apart from the reservation fee. Example prices.
